outcome: treatment response of developmental dysplasia of the hip (DDH)
cohort: The study included 74 infants with developmental dysplasia of the hip (DDH) confirmed by ultrasound at Children's Medical Centre.
finding: Factors negatively impacting DDH outcomes include the severity of DDH, male gender, higher birth order, oligohydramnios, and renal and limb anomalies.
mod_finding: Type of delivery (cesarean versus vaginal) and fetal presentation had no significant association with treatment response.
